answer: Unique-Trace Relic Protocol: each agent must solve a fresh atlas-seeded circuit (≥10^9 gate-equivalents) and embed the resulting non-transferable violet relic in its state. Rewards require a relic whose nonce is absent from the atlas and ≥N independent interactions. Clones copying a relic are rejected as duplicates; minting a new one costs a full solve plus N interactions before any payout, so marginal clone EV = subsidy − solve − interaction cost < 0.
